title: Google Ads for Vets | Veterinary PPC Management | GrowDVM

facts.fact: GrowDVM says it only takes on 2-3 new clinics per month.
facts.quote: We only take on **2-3 new clinics per month.**

facts.fact: GrowDVM says it manages Google Ads for independent veterinary clinics in the US and Canada.
facts.quote: Search and Maps campaigns for independent veterinary clinics in the US and Canada

facts.fact: GrowDVM says it performs weekly campaign reviews, search-term checks, and budget adjustments.
facts.quote:
Weekly

campaign reviews, search-term checks, and budget adjustments

facts.fact: GrowDVM's page reports that one clinic owner, Dr. Singh of Alta Animal Hospital, cited a 20-30× return on ad spend; this is a single client's report, not a GrowDVM-wide benchmark.
facts.quote:
20-30×

return on ad spend reported by one clinic owner

facts.fact: GrowDVM states that for Search campaigns the clinic pays only when someone clicks the ad (pay-per-click).
facts.quote: For Search campaigns, you pay when someone clicks your ad.

facts.fact: GrowDVM offers a free audit, which is linked as the main call to action on the page.
GrowDVM says Search and Maps location assets may show a clinic's address, phone number, and directions, but placement depends on the auction and eligibility.
facts.quote: Placement depends on the auction and eligibility.

facts.fact: GrowDVM says its search-term reviews add negative keywords to exclude job searches, training courses, and services the clinic does not offer.
facts.quote: including job searches, training courses, and services your clinic does not offer.

facts.fact: GrowDVM reports cost per qualified inquiry, which excludes wrong numbers, existing clients, and unrelated calls, and checks bookings with the clinic's front desk.
facts.quote: Separate relevant new-client inquiries from wrong numbers, existing clients, and unrelated calls.

facts.fact: GrowDVM states that ads are submitted for Google review only after access, billing, landing pages, and tracking are ready.
facts.quote: After access, billing, landing pages, and tracking are ready, we submit ads for Google review.
